turnaround_reason: Cable broadband is bleeding subscribers (120k lost in Q1, accelerating) amid fiber and fixed-wireless competition and the end of the ACP subsidy; the stock is down ~67% YoY. Recovery hinges on broadband stabilization, Cox merger synergies, and mobile growth.
bullish_points: Extremely cheap: forward P/E ~3.2, P/B ~1.0, EV/EBITDA 5.4
$34.5B Cox acquisition creating scale and a re-rating catalyst
Mobile line growth is a genuine bright spot
Market is pricing in outright collapse; aggressive buybacks
bearish_points: Broadband subscriber losses are structural (fiber overbuild + fixed wireless), not cyclical
120k Q1 sub losses accelerating vs 59k a year ago
Enormous leverage: $96.7B debt, D/E 441, current ratio 0.36
$11.4B capex plan through 2027 pressures near-term FCF
Cox merger adds integration and further leverage risk
catalyst: Cox merger close plus evidence broadband losses are stabilizing
catalyst_timing: Q3 earnings 2026-10-30; Cox merger close pending California approval
suggested_trade: Spot only, small — deep-value with a structural overhang; consider Jan 2027 calls only on confirmed merger close
key_risk: Broadband subscriber losses keep accelerating; cord-cutting/fiber overbuild is a permanent share-loss story
would_skip_if: Q3 shows further broadband acceleration or the merger stalls in regulatory review
